evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 7 semesters
The 7-semester programme consists of 4 semesters at International Business School in Budapest
International applicants must apply on the website of IBS.
You can apply only online by completing our online application form and uploading your documents.

notes: The programme's own page could not be identified from the supplied pages: the Tempus Studyfinder page describes the BA in Marketing - Digital Media but the IBS page of the same title was not supplied, only the related BSc in Commerce and Marketing page (the double-degree partner programme awarding the BA in Marketing - Digital Media), so programmePage is null. Tuition: the Fees page states bachelor's tuition per semester (4,000 for Dublin Business School-linked bachelor's programmes) but does not say it is a non-EU/EEA rate nor explicitly tie it to this programme; left out. Duration 7 semesters (3.5 years). Intake September 2026; the Fees page deadline of 30 September 2026* is general (the asterisk note concerns Hungarian citizens applying via FELVI.HU), not confirmed as a non-EU deadline.

evidence.quote: For international applicants:• Secondary school leaving certificateAND• IELTS 6.0 or equivalent***
*** i.e.: TOEFL 72, GCSE English, Duolingo 105 etc.

note.fr: Aucun examen d'entrée n'est exigé ; la sélection se fait sur le diplôme de fin d'études secondaires.
note.en: No entrance examination is required; selection is based on the secondary school leaving certificate.
